Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces '''annexed''' the [[Cassandran Worlds/Legends|Cassandran Worlds]], a loosely-allied region of space in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The split the region into three [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] named [[Cassander subsector|Cassander]], [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin]], and [[Tendrannan sector/Legends|Tendrannan]].<ref name="GatORW" />
